title: Fragment-nested `<Frame>` doesn't adopt its hydration marker
author: markmals
body_preview: A `<Frame>` that is the first child of a bare `<Fragment>` (`<>`) returned by a `clientEntry` fails to adopt its server-rendered frame markers during hydration. It takes the fresh-insert path instead, duplicating the streamed subtree and re-fetching `src` on the client. Wrapping the same `<Frame>` in a host element (e.g. `<div>`) makes it hydrate cleanly.
